name: DTR decision
query:
WITH latest AS (SELECT payload, event_time, received_at FROM events WHERE event_type_id = 'e0ba0d5d-bc36-46a9-855e-dcb3697e5ca8' AND payload->>'demo_site' = 'dertour' AND payload->>'synthetic' = 'true' ORDER BY event_time DESC, received_at DESC LIMIT 1), classified AS (SELECT *, CASE
 WHEN payload->>'complaint'='true' THEN 'care'
 WHEN payload->>'stage'='cancelled' THEN 'cancelled'
 WHEN payload->>'stage'='booked' AND (payload->>'departure_date')::timestamp >= (payload->>'demo_clock')::timestamp AND (payload->>'departure_date')::timestamp <= (payload->>'demo_clock')::timestamp + interval '14 days' AND payload->>'transfer_owned'='false' THEN 'pretrip'
 WHEN payload->>'stage'='booked' THEN 'service'
 WHEN payload->>'stage'='completed' AND payload->>'feedback_received'='false' THEN 'feedback'
 WHEN payload->>'stage'='completed' THEN 'rebook'
 WHEN payload->>'stage'='checkout' AND (payload->>'quote_expires_at')::timestamp < (payload->>'demo_clock')::timestamp THEN 'expired'
 WHEN payload->>'stage'='checkout' AND (payload->>'last_action_at')::timestamp <= (payload->>'demo_clock')::timestamp - interval '30 minutes' THEN 'recovery'
 WHEN payload->>'stage'='checkout' THEN 'waiting'
 WHEN payload->>'watch_active'='true' AND payload->>'watch_permission'='true' AND (payload->>'watch_price')::numeric <= (payload->>'watch_threshold')::numeric AND (payload->>'watch_expires_at')::timestamp > (payload->>'demo_clock')::timestamp THEN 'price'
 WHEN (payload->>'history_count')::numeric>=4 THEN 'vip'
 WHEN (payload->>'last_trip_days')::numeric>=365 THEN 'winback'
 WHEN payload->>'stage'='research' AND (payload->>'last_action_at')::timestamp <= (payload->>'demo_clock')::timestamp-interval '2 hours' THEN 'research'
 ELSE 'inspiration' END AS candidate FROM latest), result AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN candidate IN ('pretrip','rebook','recovery','price','vip','winback','research','inspiration') AND payload->>'email_permission'!='true' AND candidate!='price' THEN 'generic' WHEN candidate IN ('pretrip','rebook','recovery','price','vip','winback','research','inspiration') AND payload->>'experiment'='control' THEN 'control' ELSE candidate END AS decision FROM classified) SELECT payload->>'run_id' AS run_id, payload->>'revision' AS revision, payload->>'demo_clock' AS demo_clock, payload->>'stage' AS stage, payload->>'destination' AS destination, decision, CASE WHEN decision='generic' THEN 'Marketing permission not granted' WHEN decision='control' THEN 'Persistent control assignment: neutral experience' WHEN decision='care' THEN 'Open service case suppresses marketing' WHEN decision='recovery' THEN 'Incomplete checkout, 30-minute delay elapsed and quote valid' WHEN decision='pretrip' THEN 'Departure within 14 days and transfer not owned' WHEN decision='price' THEN 'Opted-in watch threshold met on a current offer' WHEN decision='vip' THEN 'Four or more completed demo trips' WHEN decision='winback' THEN 'Lapsed traveler with no active booking' WHEN decision='expired' THEN 'Quote expired: new search required' ELSE 'Lifecycle and consent rules evaluated by Meiro' END AS reason, CASE WHEN decision IN ('pretrip','rebook','recovery','price','vip','winback','research','inspiration') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS marketing, CASE WHEN payload->>'ads_permission'!='true' THEN 'no_permission' WHEN payload->>'stage' IN ('booked','completed','cancelled') THEN 'acquisition_excluded' ELSE 'research_eligible' END AS media_eligibility FROM result
